hints.title: Invariant Sum Conservation
hints.text: Because both merge and split operations conserve the total sum, target and source sums must match.

hints.title: State Transition Graph
hints.text: Model array configurations as vertices where edges represent adjacent merges or integer splits.

hints.title: Queue Level Exploration
hints.text: Explore array transformations level by level with visited tracking to determine shortest distance.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: B: branching factor of split/merge transitions
complexity.notes: Breadth-first search over array transformation states.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded recursive search loops infinitely over cyclic configurations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited set memorizes array states to prune redundant explorations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the shortest-path state space search with visited tracking.
